hypermethylated.interpretation: High-level methylation of the gene promoter detected.
hypermethylated.clinical_significance: Strongly associated with silencing of gene expression. Suggests favorable response to alkylating chemotherapy (e.g., temozolomide) and improved prognosis. High confidence in benefit from therapy.

methylated.interpretation: Gene promoter methylation detected at a moderate level.
methylated.clinical_significance: Suggests reduced gene expression and likely benefit from alkylating agents. Prognostic and predictive significance is positive, though potentially less strong than in hypermethylated cases.

unmethylated.interpretation: No significant methylation of the gene promoter detected.
unmethylated.clinical_significance: Suggests active gene expression and decreased likelihood of benefit from alkylating chemotherapy. Prognosis may be less favorable.

indeterminate.interpretation: Methylation levels fall near assay threshold; cannot confidently classify as methylated or unmethylated.
indeterminate.clinical_significance: Predictive and prognostic implications uncertain. Repeat testing or alternative assays may be considered.

inconclusive.interpretation: No result due to insufficient tumor content, poor DNA quality, or technical issues.
inconclusive.clinical_significance: Recommend repeat testing if result is needed for treatment planning.

MGMT.central_nervous_system: MGMT methylation predicts response to temozolomide
MGMT.colorectal: MGMT methylation may be evaluated for its role in chemosensitivity
MGMT.endometrial: MGMT methylation may be evaluated for its role in chemosensitivity

MLH1.central_nervous_system: To evaluate mismatch repair (MMR) deficiency/microsatellite instability
MLH1.colorectal: Promoter hypermethylation is a common cause of sporadic MSI-high tumors
MLH1.endometrial: Promoter hypermethylation is a common cause of sporadic MSI-high tumors
MLH1.hereditary: Hypermethylation indicates a sporadic origin of Lynch-like tumors, ruling out germline mutation

CDKN2A.central_nervous_system: Hypermethylation associated with aggressive behavior in some gliomas
CDKN2A.colorectal: Screened for p16INK4a, may be methylated in some gastrointestinal tumors
CDKN2A.endometrial: Screened for p16INK4a, may be methylated in some gastrointestinal tumors
CDKN2A.hematologic: Methylation associated with prognosis in some leukemias and lymphomas

WT1.hematologic: Aberrantly methylated in Acute Myeloid Leukemia.

BRCA1.hereditary: Promoter hypermethylation can be observed in some sporadic triple-negative breast cancers.

CDKN2B.hematologic: Screened for p15INK4b, frequently methylated in acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL)

VHL.hereditary: Methylation may be evaluated in the context of clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
